name: matthew-studio-kit
description: Edit raw talking-head clips into finished Shorts and long-form videos in saved styles. Watch the whole edit live in HyperFrames Studio before anything renders; b-roll, pictures and graphics from your Notion library; QA-gated.

interface.shortDescription: Shorts and long-form, previewed live before they render.
interface.longDescription: Draft, watch the whole edit live in HyperFrames Studio, change anything by asking or by hand, then render once and QA. Your look lives in a style you change by asking; old versions are kept. B-roll, pictures and sound effects come from your Notion library; graphics from HyperFrames' block library.
defaultPrompt: Edit the clip in inbox with the matthew style.
Make a 15 second Short from this clip.
Make my captions a little smaller.
Make a long-form video from the clip in inbox.
